text: Handling deadlines well requires a few key skills. First, good time management helps you plan your work and avoid last-minute stress. Second, prioritization is important: focus on the most urgent and important tasks first, and leave less critical ones for later. Third, scope management means being realistic about what you can finish. If a task is too big, break it into smaller parts or reduce what you try to do. Finally, communication matters. If you realize you may miss a deadline, tell your teacher, boss, or teammates early, and explain the situation. Clear communication builds trust, and people can often help you find a solution.
